1: Click on a dino from the menu on the right, then click in the playable area to place the dino.
2: Select a placed tower to view its upgrade paths. Upgrades are often stronger than placing only new towers.
3: Make sure you place dinos in spots that let them attack the most enemies!
4: Different towers solve different problems. Fast enemies, armored enemies, and groups may need different answers.
6: Support towers (Dilophosaurus) can be just as important as damage towers when waves start getting crowded.
